{
  "name": "schedule_joint_meeting",
  "request_shape": "Find a free one-hour slot next week that works for both Dana Reyes and Sam Okafor, and propose it to them.",
  "inputs": [],
  "steps": [
    {
      "id": "get_dana_calendar",
      "kind": "lookup_via_agent",
      "inputs": [],
      "output": "dana_availability",
      "agent": "calendar",
      "find": "Dana Reyes"
    },
    {
      "id": "get_sam_calendar",
      "kind": "lookup_via_agent",
      "inputs": [],
      "output": "sam_availability",
      "agent": "calendar",
      "find": "Sam Okafor"
    },
    {
      "id": "extract_next_week_dates",
      "kind": "list",
      "inputs": [],
      "output": "next_week_dates",
      "source": "calendar",
      "filter": "next_week"
    },
    {
      "id": "compute_free_slots",
      "kind": "loop_over_items",
      "inputs": ["next_week_dates"],
      "output": "free_slots",
      "over": "next_week_dates",
      "steps": [
        {
          "id": "check_dana_free",
          "kind": "classify",
          "inputs": ["next_week_dates", "dana_availability"],
          "output": "dana_free",
          "question": "Is Dana Reyes free at this time?",
          "enum": ["yes", "no"]
        },
        {
          "id": "check_sam_free",
          "kind": "classify",
          "inputs": ["next_week_dates", "sam_availability"],
          "output": "sam_free",
          "question": "Is Sam Okafor free at this time?",
          "enum": ["yes", "no"]
        },
        {
          "id": "filter_slot",
          "kind": "check_coverage",
          "inputs": ["dana_free", "sam_free"],
          "output": "slot_valid",
          "rule": "Both Dana and Sam must be free"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "select_proposal",
      "kind": "write",
      "inputs": ["free_slots"],
      "output": "proposal_text",
      "instruction": "Select the first valid one-hour slot and draft a polite proposal message to Dana Reyes and Sam Okafor suggesting this time.",
      "max_words": 50
    },
    {
      "id": "verify_proposal",
      "kind": "check_coverage",
      "inputs": ["proposal_text", "free_slots"],
      "output": "verified",
      "rule": "The proposal must reference exactly one valid free slot"
    }
  ],
  "output": "proposal_text"
}
